scenes.title: Sign In
scenes.narr: Open Our Week and sign in — each family has its own password.

scenes.title: The Week
scenes.narr: See Monday to Sunday at a glance on one shared board.

scenes.title: Add an Item
scenes.narr: Add plans with a colour flag and assign them to anyone.

scenes.title: Add Notes
scenes.narr: Tap any item to add notes — times, addresses, who brings what.

scenes.title: Print It
scenes.narr: Print the week for the fridge, or export to share it around.
